content.text: In this repo I want to add a new key map for Zed for "<leader> a" Which basically means that when I press ", a" it triggers a code action.
Let me read the current Zed keymap file first.

Index: /Users/bagwaa/Code/dotfiles/zed/keymap.json
===================================================================
--- /Users/bagwaa/Code/dotfiles/zed/keymap.json
+++ /Users/bagwaa/Code/dotfiles/zed/keymap.json
@@ -29,8 +29,9 @@
       ", s": "workspace::Save",
       ", v": "workspace::NewFileSplitVertical",
       ", h": "workspace::NewFileSplitHorizontal",
       ", x": "pane::CloseActiveItem",
+      ", a": "editor::ToggleCodeActions",
       "ctrl-h": "workspace::ActivatePaneLeft",
       "ctrl-l": "workspace::ActivatePaneRight",
       "ctrl-j": "workspace::ActivatePaneDown",
       "ctrl-k": "workspace::ActivatePaneUp",

content.text: Done. Added `, a` → `editor::ToggleCodeActions` in the vim normal mode bindings. Pressing `,` then `a` will now open the code actions menu.
